name: Park Ji-hoon
bio:
Park Ji-hoon's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. After completing his engineering degree, he initially worked in the automotive industry. However, a chance visit to a local karting event sparked a fascination with racing strategy. He spent countless hours studying race data and simulations, eventually landing a junior strategist role with a smaller racing team. 

Ji-hoon is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to quickly analyze complex situations. He emphasizes a data-driven approach, combined with an understanding of driver psychology. His focus is creating adaptable race strategies that can be adjusted on the fly based on track conditions and competitor actions. He is a highly valued member of any team, and his insight can often be the difference between a podium and a finish further down the grid.
